title: An Evening of Eschatology (panel transcript)
author: John Piper (moderator), Jim Hamilton, Sam Storms, Douglas Wilson
summary: Roundtable at Bethlehem Baptist Church, Minneapolis (27 September 2009) in which historic premillennial, amillennial and postmillennial views were defended and cross-examined.

title: Back to the Future-Present: Practical Lessons Learned from Bible Prophecy
author: Thomas Ice
summary: Ice recounts his 1988 and 1989 Dallas debates (with Dave Hunt) against Christian Reconstructionists Gary North, Gary DeMar and Kenneth Gentry.
note: Participant's own account; page located via search, not fetched in full.

title: On Solid Ground
author: Thomas Ice
summary: Ice's reply to Gary DeMar following their 26 February 2002 debate on preterism versus futurism at Biola University.

title: Answers and Clarifications for Gary DeMar
author: Thomas Ice
summary: Ice responds to DeMar's preterist arguments; Ice's writings at pre-trib.org also report a further debate with DeMar on 26 May 2006 titled 'The Great Tribulation: Past or Future?'.
note: Page exists (found via search) but could not be fetched; which Ice article reports the 2006 debate date was not confirmed.

title: The Debate Over Christian Reconstruction
author: Gary DeMar
summary: DeMar's written summary of and reply to the April 1988 Dallas debate with Dave Hunt and Thomas Ice, defending postmillennialism and biblical law.

title: The Reduction of Christianity: A Biblical Response to Dave Hunt
author: Gary DeMar and Peter J. Leithart
summary: Response to Dave Hunt's critiques of 'dominion theology'; the first half defends postmillennial optimism.

title: Dominion Theology: Blessing or Curse?
author: H. Wayne House and Thomas Ice
summary: A dispensational premillennial evaluation of theonomy and Reconstructionist postmillennialism (Multnomah).
note: URL is a review of the book.

title: House Divided: The Break-Up of Dispensational Theology
author: Greg L. Bahnsen and Kenneth L. Gentry Jr.
summary: A point-by-point theonomic postmillennial reply to House and Ice's Dominion Theology.

title: The Rapture: Pre-, Mid-, or Post-Tribulational?

summary: Zondervan multi-view volume (reissued as Three Views on the Rapture) with Feinberg (pre-trib), Archer (mid-trib) and Moo (post-trib), each answered by the others.

title: Covenantal and Dispensational Theologies: Four Views on the Continuity of Scripture
author: Brent E. Parker and Richard J. Lucas (eds.)
